name: malformed
description: The documented response is an object with a devices array. Calling .get on a list aborts a Starlark script outright, so the API answering with a bare array (which is what an error document or a proxy rewrite looks like) would take the whole import down with no diagnostic. The script shape-checks first; this proves it logs and exits cleanly with zero assets instead of crashing, and that no partial estate is emitted.

json.error: this endpoint answered with a bare array

log_contains: tailscale: no devices found, or the API call failed
